projects.name: Syrah Vidalia Active Anode Material Facility
projects.summary: Graphite active-anode-material facility with publicly documented U.S. Department of Energy financing for expansion. Production and capacity should be independently reverified as of each reporting date.
projects.source_note: DOE 27 July 2022 loan closing announcement; not a current operating-status confirmation.

projects.name: Lindi Jumbo Graphite Project
projects.company: Lindi Jumbo / Walkabout Resources (historical project disclosures)
projects.summary: Graphite project in south-eastern Tanzania near Mtwara with publicly reported mineral resources and reserves. The linked project website provides historical project statistics; current ownership and operating status require refreshed filings.
projects.status_as_of: Historical company page; current status unverified
projects.source_note: Do not confuse Lindi Jumbo with Sakariya's Tanga graphite project.

projects.name: Kalgoorlie Nickel Project / Goongarrie Hub
projects.summary: Proposed nickel-cobalt mining and processing development. Australia and United States export financing institutions have issued non-binding letters of support or interest, not confirmed project loans.
projects.source_note: Major Project Status does not itself confirm funding or operating production.
